visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins with a blue creature, Bugcat Capoo, lying on its belly on a plain white background. It holds a wooden pencil in its blue paws and draws a squiggly line on a white sheet of paper. A small blue-and-white eraser sits nearby on the paper. The lighting is flat and bright. (2) Capoo reaches for the eraser, but as it picks it up, the object is revealed to be a small white dog-like creature inside a plastic wrapper. Capoo attempts to use the dog as an eraser, then bites into the wrapper. The scene cuts to Capoo spitting out the white dog, which lands on the floor. (3) A new scene shows Capoo sitting on the back of a large, elongated yellow dog. Capoo uses two small wooden logs as drumsticks to rhythmically tap on the yellow dog's head. The dog has a neutral, drooping expression. The background remains a solid, minimalist gray-white. (4) Capoo is shown holding a ball of yellow yarn. The small white dog appears and uses knitting needles to quickly knit the yarn into a small cup-shaped object. Capoo watches with a joyful, open-mouthed expression and tiny yellow wings appearing on its back as it cheers. (5) Capoo places the white dog into a light blue zippered pouch. In the next shot, Capoo holds up a mirror to the white dog, which is now wearing a yellow knitted sweater. Both characters look extremely happy, with yellow sparkles and heart shapes floating in the air. (6) The final segment shows Capoo back at the drawing board, lying on the floor and sketching. The small white dog is curled up sleeping peacefully next to Capoo's head. The text 'BUGCAT CAPOO' is visible at the bottom of the frame.
